faq.q: How many people sit around it?
faq.a: Closed, at {{LEN_CLOSED}} cm: up to {{SEATS_CLOSED}}. Open, at {{LEN_OPEN}}: up to {{SEATS_OPEN}}. The number depends on the width of your chairs and on the trestle positions; the seats in the dimensions drawing are illustrative only.

faq.q: What is the top made of, and how is it cared for?
faq.a: Oak veneer on a plywood core, a solid-oak edge and a matte oil-wax finish. The core is not solid oak. Detailed care instructions come with the call and the written proposal.

faq.q: What does delivery include, and what should be checked first?
faq.a: Delivery and assembly are included in the price. The table arrives in two cartons: {{BOX_A}} cm and {{BOX_B}} cm. Lift, stairwell and door width are checked with you on the call, before ordering.
{{LEAD_WEEKS}} weeks from written order confirmation. We are pre-launch: nothing is in stock, and every table goes into production after it is ordered.
Not on this site. After the call you receive a written proposal with the specification, price, delivery date and payment terms. Only what is confirmed in writing is binding.
No transaction takes place on this site, so there is nothing here to cancel. Cancellation terms appear in the written proposal before any payment, subject to the Israeli Consumer Protection Law.
